Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL1121833. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1121833'. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
